units.leftText: How the city sits solitary,
units.rightText: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people!

units.leftText: She weeps bitterly in the night.
units.rightText: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks;

units.leftText: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction
units.rightText: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude;

units.leftText: The roads to Zion mourn,
units.rightText: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn assembly;

units.leftText: Her adversaries have become the head.
units.rightText: Her adversaries are become the head, her enemies prosper;

units.leftText: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: And from the daughter of Zion all her majesty is departed:

units.leftText: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries
units.rightText: Jerusalem remembereth in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old:

units.leftText: Jerusalem has grievously sinned.
units.rightText: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is become as an unclean thing;

units.leftText: Her filthiness was in her skirts.
units.rightText: Her filthiness was in her skirts; she remembered not her latter end;

units.leftText: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things;
units.rightText: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things:

units.leftText: All her people sigh.
units.rightText: All her people sigh, they seek bread;

units.leftText: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by?
units.rightText: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by?

units.leftText: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones,
units.rightText: From on high hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them;

units.leftText: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand.
units.rightText: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand;

units.leftText: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me.
units.rightText: The Lord hath set at nought all my mighty men in the midst of me;

units.leftText: “For these things I weep.
units.rightText: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water;

units.leftText: Zion spreads out her hands.
units.rightText: Zion spreadeth forth her hands; there is none to comfort her;

units.leftText: “The LORD is righteous,
units.rightText: Jehovah is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment:

units.leftText: “I called for my lovers,
units.rightText: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me:

units.leftText: “Look, LORD; for I am in distress.
units.rightText: Behold, O Jehovah; for I am in distress; my heart is troubled;

units.leftText: “They have heard that I sigh.
units.rightText: They have heard that I sigh; there is none to comfort me;

units.leftText: “Let all their wickedness come before you.
units.rightText: Let all their wickedness come before thee;

units.leftText: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger!
units.rightText: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger!

units.leftText: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob
units.rightText: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied:

units.leftText: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger.
units.rightText: He hath cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel;

units.leftText: He has bent his bow like an enemy.
units.rightText: He hath bent his bow like an enemy, he hath stood with his right hand as an adversary,

units.leftText: The Lord has become as an enemy.
units.rightText: The Lord is become as an enemy, he hath swallowed up Israel;

units.leftText: He has violently taken away his tabernacle,
units.rightText: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden; he hath destroyed his place of assembly:

units.leftText: The Lord has cast off his altar.
units.rightText: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary;

units.leftText: The LORD has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion;

units.leftText: Her gates have sunk into the ground.
units.rightText: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars:

units.leftText: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground.
units.rightText: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, they keep silence;

units.leftText: My eyes fail with tears.
units.rightText: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my heart is troubled;

units.leftText: They ask their mothers,
units.rightText: They say to their mothers, Where is grain and wine?

units.leftText: What shall I testify to you?
units.rightText: What shall I testify unto thee? what shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem?

units.leftText: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you.
units.rightText: Thy prophets have seen for thee false and foolish visions;

units.leftText: All that pass by clap their hands at you.
units.rightText: All that pass by clap their hands at thee;

units.leftText: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you.
units.rightText: All thine enemies have opened their mouth wide against thee;

units.leftText: The LORD has done that which he planned.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath done that which he purposed; he hath fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old;

units.leftText: Their heart cried to the Lord.
units.rightText: Their heart cried unto the Lord:

units.leftText: Arise, cry out in the night,
units.rightText: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches;

units.leftText: “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus!
units.rightText: See, O Jehovah, and behold to whom thou hast done thus!

units.leftText: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets.
units.rightText: The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets;

units.leftText: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side.
units.rightText: Thou hast called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side;

units.leftText: I am the man who has seen affliction
units.rightText: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

units.leftText: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness,
units.rightText: He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

units.leftText: Surely he turns his hand against me
units.rightText: Surely against me he turneth his hand again and again all the day.

units.leftText: He has made my flesh and my skin old.
units.rightText: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

units.leftText: He has built against me,
units.rightText: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

units.leftText: He has made me dwell in dark places,
units.rightText: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

units.leftText: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out.
units.rightText: He hath walled me about, that I cannot go forth; he hath made my chain heavy.

units.leftText: Yes, when I cry, and call for help,
units.rightText: Yea, when I cry, and call for help, he shutteth out my prayer.

units.leftText: He has walled up my ways with cut stone.
units.rightText: He hath walled up my ways with hewn stone; he hath made my paths crooked.

units.leftText: He is to me as a bear lying in wait,
units.rightText: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.

units.leftText: He has turned away my path,
units.rightText: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he hath made me desolate.

units.leftText: He has bent his bow,
units.rightText: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

units.leftText: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
units.rightText: He hath caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my reins.

units.leftText: I have become a derision to all my people,
units.rightText: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.

units.leftText: He has filled me with bitterness.
units.rightText: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath sated me with wormwood.

units.leftText: He has also broken my teeth with gravel.
units.rightText: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he hath covered me with ashes.

units.leftText: You have removed my soul far away from peace.
units.rightText: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace; I forgat prosperity.

units.leftText: I said, “My strength has perished,
units.rightText: And I said, My strength is perished, and mine expectation from Jehovah.

units.leftText: Remember my affliction and my misery,
units.rightText: Remember mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

units.leftText: My soul still remembers them,
units.rightText: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is bowed down within me.

units.leftText: This I recall to my mind;
units.rightText: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.

units.leftText: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed,
units.rightText: It is of Jehovah’s lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

units.leftText: They are new every morning.
units.rightText: They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.

units.leftText: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

units.leftText: The LORD is good to those who wait for him,
units.rightText: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

units.leftText: It is good that a man should hope
units.rightText: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Jehovah.

units.leftText: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
units.rightText: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

units.leftText: Let him sit alone and keep silence,
units.rightText: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he hath laid it upon him.

units.leftText: Let him put his mouth in the dust,
units.rightText: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.

units.leftText: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him.
units.rightText: Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him; let him be filled full with reproach.

units.leftText: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
units.rightText: For the Lord will not cast off for ever.

units.leftText: For though he causes grief,
units.rightText: For though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

units.leftText: For he does not afflict willingly,
units.rightText: For he doth not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

units.leftText: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
units.rightText: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

units.leftText: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
units.rightText: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

units.leftText: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
units.rightText: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

units.leftText: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass,
units.rightText: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

units.leftText: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
units.rightText: Out of the mouth of the Most High cometh there not evil and good?

units.leftText: Why should a living man complain,
units.rightText: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

units.leftText: Let us search and try our ways,
units.rightText: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Jehovah.

units.leftText: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
units.rightText: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

units.leftText: “We have transgressed and have rebelled.
units.rightText: We have transgressed and have rebelled; thou hast not pardoned.

units.leftText: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us.
units.rightText: Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

units.leftText: You have covered yourself with a cloud,
units.rightText: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

units.leftText: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse
units.rightText: Thou hast made us an offscouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.

units.leftText: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
units.rightText: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

units.leftText: Terror and the pit have come on us,
units.rightText: Fear and the pit are come upon us, devastation and destruction.

units.leftText: My eye runs down with streams of water,
units.rightText: Mine eye runneth down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

units.leftText: My eye pours down
units.rightText: Mine eye poureth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

units.leftText: until the LORD looks down,
units.rightText: Till Jehovah look down, and behold from heaven.

units.leftText: My eye affects my soul,
units.rightText: Mine eye affecteth my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

units.leftText: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird,
units.rightText: They have chased me sore like a bird, they that are mine enemies without cause.

units.leftText: They have cut off my life in the dungeon,
units.rightText: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone upon me.

units.leftText: Waters flowed over my head.
units.rightText: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.

units.leftText: I called on your name, LORD,
units.rightText: I called upon thy name, O Jehovah, out of the lowest dungeon.

units.leftText: You heard my voice:
units.rightText: Thou heardest my voice; hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

units.leftText: You came near in the day that I called on you.
units.rightText: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.

units.leftText: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul.
units.rightText: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

units.leftText: LORD, you have seen my wrong.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong; judge thou my cause.

units.leftText: You have seen all their vengeance
units.rightText: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.

units.leftText: You have heard their reproach, LORD,
units.rightText: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, and all their devices against me,

units.leftText: the lips of those that rose up against me,
units.rightText: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

units.leftText: You see their sitting down and their rising up.
units.rightText: Behold thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.

units.leftText: You will pay them back, LORD,
units.rightText: Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O Jehovah, according to the work of their hands.

units.leftText: You will give them hardness of heart,
units.rightText: Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, thy curse unto them.

units.leftText: You will pursue them in anger,
units.rightText: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.

units.leftText: How the gold has become dim!
units.rightText: How is the gold become dim! how is the most pure gold changed!

units.leftText: The precious sons of Zion,
units.rightText: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold,

units.leftText: Even the jackals offer their breast.
units.rightText: Even the jackals draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones:

units.leftText: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst.
units.rightText: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst:

units.leftText: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets.
units.rightText: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets:

units.leftText: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom,
units.rightText: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom,

units.leftText: Her nobles were purer than snow.
units.rightText: Her nobles were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk;

units.leftText: Their appearance is blacker than a coal.
units.rightText: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets:

units.leftText: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger;
units.rightText: They that are slain with the sword are better than they that are slain with hunger;

units.leftText: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children.
units.rightText: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children;

units.leftText: The LORD has accomplished his wrath.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath accomplished his wrath, he hath poured out his fierce anger;

units.leftText: The kings of the earth didn’t believe,
units.rightText: The kings of the earth believed not, neither all the inhabitants of the world,

units.leftText: It is because of the sins of her prophets
units.rightText: It is because of the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests,

units.leftText: They wander as blind men in the streets.
units.rightText: They wander as blind men in the streets, they are polluted with blood,

units.leftText: “Go away!” they cried to them.
units.rightText: Depart ye, they cried unto them, Unclean! depart, depart, touch not!

units.leftText: The LORD’s anger has scattered them.
units.rightText: The anger of Jehovah hath scattered them; he will no more regard them:

units.leftText: Our eyes still fail,
units.rightText: Our eyes do yet fail in looking for our vain help:

units.leftText: They hunt our steps,
units.rightText: They hunt our steps, so that we cannot go in our streets:

units.leftText: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky.
units.rightText: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens:

units.leftText: The breath of our nostrils,
units.rightText: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Jehovah, was taken in their pits;

units.leftText: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom,
units.rightText: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz:

units.leftText: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity:

units.leftText: Remember, LORD, what has come on us.
units.rightText: Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us:

units.leftText: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,
units.rightText: Our inheritance is turned unto strangers,

units.leftText: We are orphans and fatherless.
units.rightText: We are orphans and fatherless;

units.leftText: We must pay for water to drink.
units.rightText: We have drunken our water for money;

units.leftText: Our pursuers are on our necks.
units.rightText: Our pursuers are upon our necks:

units.leftText: We have given our hands to the Egyptians,
units.rightText: We have given the hand to the Egyptians,

units.leftText: Our fathers sinned, and are no more.
units.rightText: Our fathers sinned, and are not;

units.leftText: Servants rule over us.
units.rightText: Servants rule over us:

units.leftText: We get our bread at the peril of our lives,
units.rightText: We get our bread at the peril of our lives,

units.leftText: Our skin is black like an oven,
units.rightText: Our skin is black like an oven,

units.leftText: They ravished the women in Zion,
units.rightText: They ravished the women in Zion,

units.leftText: Princes were hanged up by their hands.
units.rightText: Princes were hanged up by their hand:

units.leftText: The young men carry millstones.
units.rightText: The young men bare the mill;

units.leftText: The elders have ceased from the gate,
units.rightText: The elders have ceased from the gate,

units.leftText: The joy of our heart has ceased.
units.rightText: The joy of our heart is ceased;

units.leftText: The crown has fallen from our head.
units.rightText: The crown is fallen from our head:

units.leftText: For this our heart is faint.
units.rightText: For this our heart is faint;

units.leftText: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate.
units.rightText: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate:

units.leftText: You, LORD, remain forever.
units.rightText: Thou, O Jehovah, abidest for ever;

units.leftText: Why do you forget us forever,
units.rightText: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever,

units.leftText: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned.
units.rightText: Turn thou us unto thee, O Jehovah, and we shall be turned;

units.leftText: But you have utterly rejected us.
units.rightText: But thou hast utterly rejected us;
